# P26 — Independent FIN authorization and revision invalidation

Status: **blocked_external**. Bounded local typed FIN adapter and named local P26_A1–A3 checks delivered; actual institutional/provider/concurrency/privacy/human gates remain. No P27.

## Delivered contract and scope

Migration034;73tables/809columns/99public functions. Six forced-RLS/raw-grant-denied tables model official designation/version/alternate, pinned external/routing policy, assignment-policy binding, immutable authorization/event and explicitly excluded contact metadata. No actual designation, policy, role grant, threshold or waiver is seeded. Exact interfaces and security/state policy: docs/finance.md.

Typed activation/decision connects to P22 canonical workflow_instances/approval_assignments/approval_decisions/events, P24 immutable finance/hash/amount and P12 exact manifest bytes. Requester/beneficiary self-approval is denied. Current official same-unit finance.review designation plus explicit primary/alternate relationship is required; PM/department labels cannot substitute. Current role/deployment/admission/term/person/policy and canonical version/revision are rechecked and locked. Policy insertion shares a transaction advisory lock; assignment binds the exact policy version. Generic FIN transitions cannot issue financial authorization.

Approve records exact request/finance revision/hash, immutable requested total/purpose, partial ceiling, conditions, finite Manila-term expiry, required external outcome and selected evidence. Composite FKs bind finance revision/request/hash, assignment/policy and canonical decision; a guard repeats original amount/purpose/approve semantics. Unique assignment decision + canonical row locks + exact actor/key/payload retry + atomic audit/outbox prevent local stale/conflicting/replayed transitions. No amount, purpose, evidence or old decision is rewritten. No general service clearance, actual revenue, payment or ledger is generated.

Derived valid/pending_external/expired/revoked/superseded state invalidates readiness for governed revision/draft/cancel, newer policy, lost authority, expiry or explicit revocation. External not_required comes only from confirmed policy; required evidence can remain pending, or an authorized FIN officer records verification of the exact selected immutable manifest. New evidence requires a new governed revision. Excluded contact-label changes have their own audited version command outside the governed hash and preserve authorization. Approved FIN cases can explicitly start a revision.

Scoped FIN metadata queue, current assigned private snapshot/selected-file download, partial decision/conditions/expiry/external outcome, revocation and excluded metadata controls are wired at /finance/reviews/:term/:request. Own finance pages show the recorded ceiling/state separately from original request and actuals. Shared tasks/deliverables receive only a neutral state, including authorized only when all currently linked typed plans are valid. No case IDs/counts/titles/amounts/files cross this summary. Identity-bound in-memory uncertain commands retain exact payload/key and lock inputs; no optimistic grant or browser private persistence.

**Routing limit:** this adapter supports explicitly confirmed single-stage, one-reviewer terminal FIN policies. Other/sequential/all-reviewer financial mappings remain paused. Actual institutional workflow is still an open input; if approved routing differs, extend and verify its typed mapping before activation. No proposed head/PM endorsement is invented or bypassed. The local supported interface can support P27 independent work; live activation remains gated.
